questions.question: Explain how to open the ledger accounts of the repair business on 1 April, including folio numbers and opening balances. On which side is each of these brought down: bank R74 180, capital R60 000, wages R6 000, loan R25 000, current income R15 900?
questions.expected_answer: Draw a T-account for each account with its name and folio (B for balance sheet, N for nominal); enter 1 April, Balance, b/d and the amount on the account's normal side; open new accounts (repair parts, rent expense, insurance) with no balance. Debit: bank R74 180, wages R6 000. Credit: capital R60 000, loan R25 000, current income R15 900.

questions.question: Describe the posting of the April CRJ (bank R31 330; current income R18 650; sundry: capital R10 000, rent income R2 500, interest income R180) and CPJ (bank R25 325; wages R6 000; repair parts R4 200; sundry R15 125), giving the side, details and folio, and show that debits equal credits for each journal.
questions.expected_answer: CRJ: Dr Bank R31 330 'Total receipts' CRJ 4; Cr Current income R18 650, Cr Capital R10 000, Cr Rent income R2 500, Cr Interest income R180, each 'Bank' CRJ 4; 18 650 + 10 000 + 2 500 + 180 = 31 330. CPJ: Cr Bank R25 325 'Total payments' CPJ 4; Dr Wages R6 000, Dr Repair parts R4 200, and each sundry amount (rent expense 4 500, stationery 680, drawings 2 500, water and electricity 1 380, equipment 5 200, bank charges 245, insurance 620) to the debit of its own account, details 'Bank', CPJ 4; 6 000 + 4 200 + 15 125 = 25 325.

questions.question: Balance the bank account at 30 April (opening R74 180 Dr; total receipts R31 330; total payments R25 325) and explain c/d and b/d.
questions.expected_answer: Debit side 74 180 + 31 330 = 105 510; credit side 25 325; difference 80 185. Write 30 April Balance c/d R80 185 on the credit (smaller) side; both sides total R105 510, ruled off; bring down 1 May Balance b/d R80 185 on the debit side (favourable balance, asset). c/d closes the month; b/d opens the next on the opposite side.
